build_transform_request: build a request payload for the fal-ai/ideogram/v3 image generation API with a text prompt
map_openai_params: map OpenAI-style image generation parameters like n, size, and response_format to the Ideogram v3 request schema
map_image_size: map OpenAI image size strings such as 1024x1024 to Ideogram v3 image size values like square_hd
parse_image_response: parse the fal-ai/ideogram/v3 JSON response into a list of ImageObject entries with URLs
get_supported_openai_params: get the list of supported OpenAI image generation parameters for the fal-ai/ideogram/v3 model
